create_instructblip_processor: create an InstructBlipProcessor with image_processor, tokenizer, qformer_tokenizer and optional num_query_tokens
call_processor_with_text_and_images: call InstructBlipProcessor with images and text to produce batched encoding with qformer input ids and attention masks
call_processor_with_text_only: call InstructBlipProcessor with text only to produce qformer encoding without image tokens
call_processor_with_images_only: call InstructBlipProcessor with images only to produce image encoding without text tokens
get_model_input_names: get the combined model_input_names property listing tokenizer, image_processor and qformer input names
